vulns.title: deposit truncates shares to zero on an inflated pool enabling a first-depositor donation attack
vulns.root_cause: reward_pool::deposit mints shares as `(amount * pool.total_shares) / balance::value(&pool.balance)` using integer division, with no guard that the result is nonzero. An attacker who is the first depositor (and holds the PoolAdmin cap) deposits a tiny amount to mint 1 share, then inflates pool.balance far above the share supply via add_rewards. A later victim's normal deposit D then truncates to 0 shares because D * total_shares < balance, gifting their deposit to the attacker's outstanding share. The fix asserts the minted shares are nonzero in deposit.
